datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule across Niger in 2016. Geographic boundaries and food insecurity phase classifications were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing different scenarios and time periods (February, June, October 2016). The dataset provides spatial representations of acute food insecurity severity across administrative units.
